blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The new impeachment trial voting threshold of 14 can only be challenged in the Supreme Court if the senator-judges actually convict Vice President Sara Duterte, House prosecutor Chel Diokno said on Wednesday. Diokno stated that position after Senator-Judge Alan Peter Cayetano asked whether the Senate impeachment court or the SC should settle the threshold dispute. “Your Honor, I believe that the matter is not yet justiciable and cannot yet be brought to the Supreme Court,” Diokno said.
